### VPN & Tor: browser extensions
- With VPN & Tor blocking on, over 100 VPN and Tor browser extensions are now recognised. Opening one closes it, and the browser shows a page asking you to remove it, with a button that opens the extensions page. - In Chrome and similar browsers an extension is caught when it is opened; in browsers whose files macOS lets Kahf Guard read, it is caught as soon as the browser is in front. - More VPN apps are blocked, including Safari VPN apps from the App Store, Touch VPN, nthLink, Ultrasurf, Shadowsocks, V2rayU and sing-box.
### Also in this update
- The block page for a filtered Reels or Shorts screen offers "Back to" the site instead of closing the tab.
